title: The odds and ends a level hides
target: The smaller set pieces in R.E.P.O. — named potions, a set of gnomes and the head in the museum — so a strange thing in a level can be read for what it is.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A level with valuables in it
A crew that will not smash everything

steps.do: Expect potions to be valuables in their own right rather than props.
steps.because: four potions are named as kinds of valuable in their own right (ValuableLovePotion, ValuableSmallPotion, ValuableLevitationPotion, ValuableSpiderPotion)

steps.do: Stand back from the levitation potion.
steps.because: the levitation potion carries a sphere for levitation (levitationSphere)

steps.do: Pick the small potion up carefully, because it carries a health pool and a healing aura and breaks into particles.
steps.because: the small potion holds a health pool and a healing aura and breaks into particles (healthPool, healAura, breakParticles)

steps.do: Treat the gnomes as one set piece rather than as separate monsters.
steps.because: a director keeps the gnomes as a set, with a list of them and a state of its own (EnemyGnomeDirector, gnomes, currentState)

steps.do: Expect them to close on you at different speeds.
steps.because: each gnome moves at a speed between a minimum and a maximum (speedMin, speedMax)

steps.do: Watch how they avoid each other rather than expecting a straight line.
steps.because: they have a collider for avoiding each other and an offset for backing away (avoidCollider, backAwayOffset)

steps.do: Listen for the pickaxe, because its warning and its hit are separate sounds.
steps.because: the pickaxe has a tell and a hit as separate sounds (soundPickaxeTell, soundPickaxeHit)

steps.do: Give the museum's head room, because opening it is staged.
steps.because: it is a head that opens and closes with its own transforms and sounds, an animation curve and a lights curve, open particles and a spot light, and eyes with a red state, a cooldown curve and a colour used while cooling (headTransform, headTopTransform, headBottomTransform, soundOpen, soundClose, animationCurve, animationCurveLights, particlesOpen, spotLight, evilEyes, soundRedEyes, animationCurveEyesCoolDown, colorCooldown, fireEyes)

commonMistakes: Treating a named potion as ordinary loot and carrying it into a fight.
Meeting the gnomes as if they were a single monster.
Standing next to the museum head while it is opening.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
